note: EX-001..EX-024 are the source starter library. EX-S### are stub records for movements the source names but does not describe; they carry no technique or safety text.

records.name: Barbell bench press
records.execution: Set eyes under bar; retract/stabilise shoulder blades; lower under control; press smoothly
records.safety: Spotter/safeties; stop for sharp pain; avoid uncontrolled bounce

records.name: Push-up
records.execution: Hands set comfortably; body aligned; lower chest between hands; press floor away
records.safety: Regress to incline push-up; maintain trunk position

records.name: Incline dumbbell press
records.execution: Use modest incline; control descent; press without clashing dumbbells
records.safety: Choose pain-free range; avoid excessive arch

records.name: Lat pulldown
records.execution: Brace; pull elbows down; avoid excessive swing; control return
records.safety: Do not pull behind neck as default

records.name: Chest-supported row
records.execution: Support torso; pull toward lower ribs; control stretch
records.safety: Avoid shrugging and momentum

records.name: Overhead press
records.execution: Brace; press overhead while keeping ribcage controlled
records.safety: Use pain-free range; do not force mobility

records.name: Lateral raise
records.execution: Raise arms in comfortable scapular plane; control lowering
records.safety: Avoid swinging heavy loads
records.pattern_note: Single-joint / aerobic action; not in the section 1.2 taxonomy

records.name: Cable triceps pressdown
records.execution: Keep upper arm steady; extend elbow; control return
records.safety: Use comfortable wrist/elbow position
records.pattern_note: Single-joint / aerobic action; not in the section 1.2 taxonomy

records.name: Dumbbell curl
records.execution: Keep upper arm relatively stable; curl without torso swing
records.safety: Avoid forced painful range
records.pattern_note: Single-joint / aerobic action; not in the section 1.2 taxonomy

records.name: Goblet squat
records.execution: Brace; sit between hips; keep whole foot grounded; stand smoothly
records.safety: Use depth that preserves control and comfort

records.name: Barbell back squat
records.execution: Brace; descend under control; maintain balance; drive up
records.safety: Use safeties; coach setup; do not force depth through pain

records.name: Leg press
records.execution: Set seat; lower sled under control; keep pelvis stable
records.safety: Avoid excessive depth that causes pelvis to roll

records.name: Romanian deadlift
records.execution: Soft knees; push hips back; keep load close; stop at controllable hamstring tension
records.safety: Avoid turning it into a squat or chasing floor touch

records.name: Conventional deadlift
records.execution: Bar over mid-foot; brace; push floor away; keep bar close
records.safety: Learn with qualified instruction; manage load and fatigue

records.name: Hip thrust
records.execution: Upper back supported; brace; extend hips; avoid lumbar overextension
records.safety: Pad bar; use tolerable range

records.name: Seated leg curl
records.execution: Align knee with machine axis; curl smoothly; control return
records.safety: Adjust seat/pad; avoid painful range
records.pattern_note: Single-joint / aerobic action; not in the section 1.2 taxonomy

records.name: Split squat
records.execution: Use stable stance; descend vertically; control front foot
records.safety: Hold support or shorten range if balance limits

records.name: Standing calf raise
records.execution: Use full comfortable range; pause briefly; control lowering
records.safety: Avoid bouncing
records.pattern_note: Single-joint / aerobic action; not in the section 1.2 taxonomy

records.name: Pallof press
records.execution: Stand tall; press hands away; resist rotation
records.safety: Use manageable resistance; breathe

records.name: Dead bug
records.execution: Brace gently; move opposite arm/leg while maintaining trunk control
records.safety: Reduce range if back position changes

records.name: Farmer carry
records.execution: Walk tall with controlled steps and steady breathing
records.safety: Choose load/path that permits safe walking

records.name: Treadmill brisk walk
records.execution: Choose sustainable pace and incline; progress gradually
records.safety: Stop for red-flag symptoms

records.name: Stationary cycling
records.execution: Adjust seat; pedal smoothly; scale resistance
records.safety: Avoid sudden volume spikes

records.name: Plank
records.execution: Maintain aligned trunk; breathe; stop before position fails
records.safety: Shorter sets are fine
